# Aleksandr Ivannikov — ivannikov.pro

> Premium engineering with AI under the hood. Production systems for B2B SaaS and Web3 teams — solo engineer, direct line, no agency layer. 13+ years of engineering, 50+ projects shipped.

Independent premium engineering studio led by Aleksandr Ivannikov. Specialises in AI engineering (agents, RAG, LLM tooling), B2B SaaS architecture, and deep Web3 expertise as adjacent capability. Operating under Abu Dhabi freelance license CN-5980378.

## Services

- [AI Optimisation](https://ivannikov.pro/services/ai-optimisation): Make your product cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI. Audit + implementation of llms.txt, schema.org, and per-page artifacts.
- [AI Development: Agents & RAG](https://ivannikov.pro/services/ai-development): Custom AI agents, RAG pipelines, and deep LLM products to automate corporate workflows and monetize your context.
- [End-to-End Product Development](https://ivannikov.pro/services/turnkey): Turnkey development of custom software, SaaS, Web3 DApps, and enterprise platforms from concept to launch.
- [React, Next.js & Mobile Dev](https://ivannikov.pro/services/mobile-web): Ultra-fast Next.js web apps and cross-platform React Native mobile apps built to scale effortlessly.
- [Expert Web3 IT Consulting](https://ivannikov.pro/services/consultation): Strategic consulting for Web3 and enterprise IT projects: architecture, security, and scalable roadmaps.
- [Build Within Telegram](https://ivannikov.pro/services/telegram-bots): Multi-functional automated Telegram bots for fast onboarding, AI customer support, and direct e-commerce.
- [High-Conversion TMA](https://ivannikov.pro/services/tma): High-converting Telegram Mini Apps (TMA) to organically engage the massive TON ecosystem.
- [Secure Smart Contract Development](https://ivannikov.pro/services/smart-contracts): Custom Solidity smart contracts for DeFi, NFT collections, DAOs, and complex tokenomics with maximum security.
- [Launch a DEX in 2 Weeks](https://ivannikov.pro/services/forks): Forking and heavy customization of battle-tested DeFi protocols (Uniswap, Curve) for speed and security.
- [Zero Downtime Guaranteed](https://ivannikov.pro/services/support): Proactive round-the-clock monitoring, fast incident response, and rapid delivery of new features.

## Portfolio (production case studies)

- [Portfolio index](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio): all case studies.
- [Roborovski NFT Collection by SYA Concept](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio/roborovski-nft): End-to-end NFT ecosystem architecture including gas-optimized smart contracts, robust anti-bot minting backend, and custom React.js frontend interface.
- [UNITS LIMITED SUPPLY (ULS) TOKEN](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio/uls-token): A cross-chain DeFi ecosystem architected from scratch. Features a unique Golden Ratio halving model, cross-chain bridging (Ethereum & Arbitrum), and automated staking mechanics.
- [World Millionaire Challenge](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio/world-millionaire-challenge): A high-frequency daily lottery platform built natively on-chain. Features comprehensive frontend dashboards, fiat/crypto top-ups, and an automated backend orchestrator for daily draws.
- [Poolex.ai DEX (AMM)](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio/poolex-ai): A high-performance Automated Market Maker (AMM) protocol built as a hardened Uniswap V2 fork on the Polygon (Matic) network.
- [GrabCoinClub NFTs infrastructure](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio/grabcoinclub-nft): Architected the complete NFT minting infrastructure for a massively-multiplayer GameFi project. Included multi-collection smart contracts, dynamic metadata engines, and backend Sybil-attack protection.
- [Fibonacci Assistant Telegram Bot](https://ivannikov.pro/portfolio/fibonacci-assistant-telegram-bot): A high-performance algorithmic trading assistant embedded directly into Telegram. Delivers real-time Fibonacci retracement calculations and market alerts.
